python3 -c "
data = open('/proc/self/status').read().split('\n')
caps = {}
for l in data:
    if 'Cap' in l and ':' in l:
        parts = l.split()
        if len(parts) >= 2:
            name = parts[0].rstrip(':')
            mask = int(parts[1], 16)
            caps[name] = mask
            bits = [i for i in range(64) if mask>>i & 1]
            print(f'{name:8} = {mask:016x}: {bits}')
"
